_about: Public-domain Johann Karl Ludwig Gieseler (1792-1854, Göttingen church historian) in English for the Word Hoard: the Text-Book of Church History in Henry B. Smith's American edition (5 vols, New York: Harper, 1857-1880), translated by Samuel Davidson, John Winstanley Hull and Henry B. Smith, the fifth volume completed by Mary A. Robinson, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gieseler-church-history-1: A Text-Book of Church History, vol. I, A.D. 1-726, tr. Samuel Davidson, ed. Henry B. Smith (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1857)
gieseler-church-history-2: A Text-Book of Church History, vol. II, A.D. 726-1305, tr. Samuel Davidson and John Winstanley Hull, ed. Henry B. Smith (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1857)
gieseler-church-history-3: A Text-Book of Church History, vol. III, A.D. 1305-1517, tr. John W. Hull, ed. Henry B. Smith (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1858)
gieseler-church-history-4: A Text-Book of Church History, vol. IV, A.D. 1517-1648, tr. and ed. Henry B. Smith (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1862)
gieseler-church-history-5: A Text-Book of Church History, vol. V, A.D. 1517-1854, tr. Henry B. Smith, completed by Mary A. Robinson (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1880)

_alternates.gieseler-clark: Clark's Edinburgh Compendium of Ecclesiastical History (1846-1856)
_alternates.gieseler-cunningham: Francis Cunningham's earlier translation (Philadelphia: Carey, Lea, and Blanchard, 1836)
